correctness.rationale: Encode independent sets as cyclic symbols 0,A,B; AA forbidden adjacent, BB forbidden two columns apart. Every length-5 window has a zero; the only nonzero four-run is ABBA, yielding α≤floor(4n/5) and matching templates. When n=5k, k zero-columns force five translates of (0ABBA)^k, each isolated under token jumps. When n=5k+4, exactly one nonzero run is length three (ABA/ABB/BBA), all others ABBA, so there are 3n optima X_i,Y_i,Z_i. A case analysis of single-symbol changes and moving a zero yields only X_i–Y_i, X_i–Z_i, Y_i–Z_{i+5}, each realizable as an edge-slide. Gcd(n,5)=1 makes this degree-two graph C_{3n}. Independently enumerated all optima and moves for n=5,9,10 from original 2n-vertex graph: counts5,27,5 and degrees0,2,0; n=9 was one 27-cycle. Inspected both exact source verification programs. These finite checks supplement the all-k word/run proof.
